d: Interior of the house of Pastor Vansen. A large fireplace on the left. To the right a door that puts on the street. Small door to the left. At the bottom of the scene a staircase of a few steps that leads to the door of a room. In front of the fireplace a rustic table. Paintings hung on the walls. Vansen sitting at the table. Constance, Women and Family coming and going.

Constance descends from the stairway holding two Girls by the hand. Marta, Carlotta also lead some Girls who bring gifts to the old Vansen. From the side door farmers and peasants enter dressed as a feast.
Vansen, and Marta.
Martha alone.
Men, women, boys, Vansen, and Constance.

The studio of a painter. It leads to the left; another small door at the bottom of the scene; tables, paintings; a stand for painting, on which a portrait of a woman is placed. Giuliano who is painting, choir of Painters and Friends.
Giuliano then the Countess of Egmont.
The Earl of Egmont, and sayings.
The above minus the Count.

The garden at the Pocherons. Avenue with very thick trees. Left a table surrounded by stone seats. At the bottom of the scene several couples of students, artists and soldiers who walk, each with his woman in the arm. Inside dance music.
Martha dressed as a moderator, then the Count of Egmont and the Marquis of Arras.
Marta and the Marquis of Arras.
The Countess of Egmont crossing the scene, and sayings.
Giuliano, and sayings.
Soldiers and Students with their Dames by arm, Count of Egmont, and sayings, young men carrying bottles and glasses.
Toilet. On the right a door, on the left a large mirror, four armchairs of ancient shape. The Countess of Egmont. A damsel.
The Earl of Egmont, and said.
The Count, the Countess.

Interior of the Louvre. To the right a gallery with statues and flower vases. To the left a large practicable staircase, covered by green carpet and flanked by artificial trees. The scene is poorly illuminated. At the bottom of the gallery, a closed door. Giuliano. Apparatori and Domestici.

The door at the end of the gallery opens. Knights and Dame enter in pairs, and cross the scene climbing through the large staircase. The Marquis d'Arras and the Countess d'Egmont give their arm. Count d'Egmont at a short distance gives the arm to a Dama. Giuliano on the side, placed so that the procession passes near him.

A street in Paris. On the right a wall with a small door. On the left a chapel of the Virgin, with a lamp on. At the bottom houses and palaces beyond the Seine. It is night. The roofs and streets are covered with snow. The Count of Egmont.
Giuliano, lead the Count.
Marta, a troop of masked men and women.
Marta and Giuliano.
